image:image.image:title: Hero’s Ride – Civil War Soldier In Battle
image:image.image:caption: A Civil War Union soldier rides into the fog of battle, flag and troops fading behind. Hooves thunder beneath me as smoke and banners fade into gray. I ride forward, heart pounding—a hero’s journey carved into history and birch alike. Collector Notes coming.
